title: Let mercy stop the wavering
summary: This meets the shaky moment when provision feels uncertain and the mind starts swaying. The line answers with the Creator's mercy and ongoing care.
takeaway: Let the Creator hold what you fear.
lifeApplication: Before spiraling over money, future, or survival, place a hand on the chest and say the line once. Remember the One who made you has not forgotten to sustain you.

source.shortMeaning: The merciful Creator sustains what He has made, so the heart can stop wavering.
source.lifeApplication: When the mind sways, remember the One who created you still carries you.
